titleEnglish: The Invincible Summoner Who Crawled Up from Level 1
titleNative: レベル１から始まる召喚無双
synopsis: After losing his father in a tragic accident, Shinobu Iijima and his younger sister Megumi are taken in by their father's old friend, Ayumu. Shinobu works hard in the hopes of starting a new life for himself. Megumi, and a mobile game called La Vita Online, are the only things keeping him afloat. One day, Ayumu reveals his true intentions of tearing Shinobu down and getting his hands on Megumi. But just after Shinobu learns that Ayumu deleted all of his game data in La Vita, their high-rise apartment catches on fire and Shinobu falls to his death, Megumi in tow. He wakes up in a strange new world... and realizes he's been reincarnated into the world of La Vita Online. An announcement from the devs tells him that Ayumu is already there, and a countdown to Megumi's arrival is ticking. Shinobu vows to protect Megumi after she arrives at any cost, even if it means he has to crawl his way up from level 1 to fend off all the other reincarnated players. (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

synopsis: High school boy Shinji Usui has a childhood friend named Hinata Ichinose — a guy who’s handsome and incredibly popular with girls, just like the hero of a rom-com. Being around Hinata, who’s as radiant and captivating as the sun, made Shinji feel pitiful by comparison, so at some point, he began to feel a bit uncomfortable around him. On the other hand, Hinata’s younger sister, Tsukina, treats him more kindly than she treats her own brother, for some reason.
